results.summary: Supply chain-driven inflation is largely over; capitalism solves these problems quickly

results.evidence: The long monologue beginning 'First, I just want to say, as I said on Patrick's podcast' is a direct self-reference to Baker's prior Invest Like the Best appearance, and the surrounding text addresses 'Gavin' by name before this response begins.

results.summary: Wage inflation is the most dangerous and historically destructive component of inflation; outcome is highly uncertain

results.summary: Technology is a structural disinflationary force that is NOT changing, regardless of deglobalization

results.evidence: Follows directly from the same speaker's response to deglobalization question ('100%. What has driven this 40-year disinflationary cycle'), continuous with Baker's prior inflation monologue.

results.summary: Solar and battery technology will displace all energy forms except nuclear within 50-70 years; this is mathematical inevitability

results.evidence: The passage 'Solar voltaic cells are compounding in efficiency at something like 8 to 10% a year' is part of the same analytical monologue responding to the ESG/commodity question directed at Baker, consistent with his prior speaking turns.

results.summary: ESG framework likely needs redefinition post-Ukraine; political sustainability of anti-drilling stance is weakening

results.summary: American energy industry has become more financially disciplined (like airlines post-restructuring), but wildcatters are filling the gap
